versions.changelog: Add skill-card.md; fix security (remove hardcoded dynamic import)

- Initial release of the book recommendation engine.
- Supports four algorithms: collaborative filtering, content similarity, trending books, and tag expansion.
- Includes 8 structured thematic booklists with must-read and difficulty labels.
- Real-time book search and popular titles via Open Library API integration.
- Wishlist feature tracks desired books, reading priority, and price monitoring.
- All core features powered by standalone Python scripts with no external dependencies.
